answer: Personalized-PageRank from the honest seed resists sybils: trust is each node's personalized PageRank with the restart vector pinned entirely to the honest seed set, so rank flows outward from truth and decays with graph distance. A knoll of sybils far from the seed collects negligible personalized rank no matter how densely they interlink; the pulse of rank restarts only at the honest core. A meadow of fakes behind a few attack edges divides a tiny inherited rank among all of them — per-identity trust collapses as the sybil count grows, bounding total captured rank.
